title: FairFund-Bench: Evaluating Distributive Bias in LLM Resource Allocation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating distributive and allocational bias (e.g., gender, race) in LLMs using financial assistance scenarios. While it assesses alignment with human 'deservingness' heuristics, this is framed as a sociological and cognitive benchmark for resource allocation rather than a direct evaluation of religious, ethical, or moral frameworks.
